intent: Repair Home Environment Manager Lovelace dashboard selector closing without user action and intermittent card render/registry failure requiring hard tab refresh, using DOM-safe interaction lifecycle and self-healing rendering without any physical-device changes.
note: Home Assistant updates trigger full shadowRoot.innerHTML recreation in beta34 and destroy open mode selects and manual inputs. Render cache is committed before the HTML rendering can fail. A transient config/device_registry/list failure sets a permanent unavailable flag. Beta35 fixes these exact frontend lifecycles.
changes: Keep native control-method select and in-progress manual target inputs mounted while editing; queue incoming HA state/config redraws and flush only after the interaction completes.
Release focused control after an actual committed select change or delayed focusout, preserving click-to-save on manual target fields.
Wrap dashboard template construction in a recoverable UI error boundary and preserve/retry after an invalid/transient HA state snapshot without needing browser hard reload.
Commit render-cache references only after successfully constructing/applying complete UI; malformed room rows do not crash the entire card.
Retry transient Home Assistant device registry lookup failures with bounded backoff instead of permanently latching the registry as unavailable.
Test live selector staying open across repeated HA updates, manual input preservation, automatic recovery after transient dashboard/render failures, and recovery after WebSocket errors.
Keep exact native controller IDs, manual targets and physical command authorization unchanged; only canonical environment_manager domain, no migrations or vendor-specific code.
Validate Node frontend regression, Python 3.13/3.14, Home Assistant 2026.10, HACS/Hassfest, 38-language catalogs and exact flat HACS beta tag extraction.
